title: calamagrostis × vassiljevii
intro: Calamagrostis × vassiljevii, commonly known as Vavilov's grass or Vavilov's feather grass, is a hybrid plant species that is a cross between Calamagrostis epigejos and Calamagrostis arundinacea. This plant has been found to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce oxidative stress and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Calamagrostis × vassiljevii include wound healing, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
